page.overview:
What is Thunder-Accumulating Mountain?

Thunder-Accumulating Mountain's peak reaches the sky, and its roots reach the source of the yellow river. The mountains size blocks out the sun, making the area around it cold regardless of the season. Streams of water flow from the mountain, feeding into the nearby dragon lagoon.
